purpose: Adjudicate whether a current public battery source can support the untouched ordinal lifetime test designed in RC57, and if none can, freeze a prospective acquisition and measurement-intervention plan.
claimBoundary: This contract does not validate an early-life feature or a lifetime model. It audits public metadata and computes prospective design sensitivity. The Farasis relationship workbook was found to contain an outcome column during header inspection; seven displayed EFC-life rows disqualify Farasis from being called untouched in this workspace, and their values are not retained in any artifact.

farasis.consequence: Farasis is ineligible as an untouched confirmation source in this workspace even independently of its group-size failure.

eligibilityGate.untouchedRequirement: No target lifetime, EOL, EFC-life, or capacity trajectory may have been inspected in the workspace that will perform confirmation.
eligibilityGate.pass: At least 36 unique cells form one explicitly declared condition group, every required edge is one-to-one, and target outcomes remain untouched.
eligibilityGate.fail: Reject a source if it has fewer than 36 cells in every declared group, if membership must be inferred, if protocol identity is incomplete, or if target outcomes have already been exposed.

prospectiveAcquisition.oneCondition: One chemistry, cell design, manufacturing lot definition, formation recipe, temperature, charge protocol, discharge protocol, voltage window, fixture boundary, and endpoint definition.
prospectiveAcquisition.randomization: Randomize cell IDs across cycler channels, chamber positions, fixture positions, and start order; retain channel, chamber, fixture, calibration, and maintenance identifiers in the manifest.
prospectiveAcquisition.featureRegister: Close the candidate coordinate after the nominal cycle-480 reference measurement. Later measurements cannot alter feature construction.
prospectiveAcquisition.endpointBranchRule: Choose the pre-registered endpoint cadence at cycle 480 using only usable-cell QC and censoring status, never target lifetime order: at least 36 usable cells selects 50 cycles; 24 to 35 selects 25 cycles; fewer than 24 stops confirmation.
prospectiveAcquisition.finalAdjudication: After intervention gates pass, require at least 24 observed events, at least 100 within-condition non-tied pairs, Harrell C at least 0.65, a lower 95% bound above 0.50, and agreement between two implementations.

attritionSensitivity.distribution: Independent binomial retention sensitivity; a planning assumption, not a claim that cell losses are independent.

measurementIntervention.multiplicityControl: Bonferroni planning bound across four one-sided equivalence tests, alpha 0.0125 per metric.
measurementIntervention.sampleSizeMeaning: Known-variance Gaussian planning floor at true difference zero. Unknown variance, clustering, attrition, and non-Gaussian tails can only increase the required parallel-arm size.
measurementIntervention.acuteSentinel: Before a long-life equivalence campaign, run a separately labelled acute randomized sequence test for fixture-induced temperature, rest-time, throughput, and impedance shifts. It can stop an unsafe or strongly perturbing design but cannot prove lifetime equivalence.
measurementIntervention.longTermGate: Only a parallel randomized conventional-versus-dense schedule study can support lifetime equivalence; do not recycle its cells into the confirmatory cohort.

orthogonalSensorBoundary.candidate: Reversible and irreversible thickness change measured under a specified mechanical boundary.
orthogonalSensorBoundary.reason: Expansion contains electrode-state information that terminal voltage can leave weakly identifiable.
orthogonalSensorBoundary.interventionRisk: Pressure and fixture stiffness are causal aging variables, not neutral sensor details. A 2026 controlled-pressure study reported a twofold lifetime difference and distinct low- and high-pressure degradation paths.
orthogonalSensorBoundary.firstTest: On sacrificial cells, compare expansion feature repeatability and electrical-feature residual information across independently calibrated fixtures while holding pressure trajectory, temperature, SOC path, and protocol fixed.
orthogonalSensorBoundary.stop: Stop calling expansion orthogonal if its apparent gain disappears after fixture-pressure adjustment, if between-fixture variance exceeds between-cell signal, or if sensing changes the degradation trajectory.

prohibited: Do not merge cells across protocols to reach 36.
Do not treat a repository-wide battery count as a same-condition replicate count.
Do not use Farasis as an untouched target in this workspace.
Do not set equivalence margins from observed arm differences.
Do not adapt endpoint cadence from observed lifetime order or candidate performance.
Do not treat a pressure-coupled expansion fixture as passive without an intervention test.
safetyAndScope: RC58 uses public metadata and offline design calculations. Any future cell cycling requires approved electrical, chemical, thermal, pressure, venting, fire-response, and emergency procedures. Cyber-trust work remains deferred.
